resumeText: Jack Wilson is a Cloud Engineer at Skyreach Media with four years of experience running AWS infrastructure. He codifies environments with Terraform, designs VPC networking and IAM, and keeps Linux workloads running reliably. Previously at Meridian Cloud he led migrations of on-premise services onto AWS. He is seeking a role where he can own and modernize a larger AWS footprint.
